name: Merrin Rockweaver
summary: On a ridge above Whelgar's Excavation Site, Merrin Rockweaver waits with the survivors. A raptor infestation drove them from the dig, where she represented the Explorers' League.

sections.title: Displaced by the Dig
sections.body: Merrin Rockweaver came to the Wetlands for the Ironforge Explorers' League, seeking ancient Titan secrets beneath the muck. The expedition fell apart when the large bones the crew unearthed drew raptors to the dig. The beasts swarmed the trenches, and Merrin and the surviving crew fled, leaving their equipment, notes, and progress behind. Now Merrin is trapped with a few survivors on a bluff overlooking the overrun ruins.

sections.title: Salvaging the Operation
sections.body: The survivors on the bluff still hope to save what they can of the expedition. Ormer Ironbraid plans vengeance against the beasts, while Prospector Whelgar seeks tablet fragments in the raptor-infested trenches. Merrin worries about her husband Tarrel, who has heard nothing from her in weeks. A scout Longbraid sent to find the team can carry word of their plight back to him.

faq.answer: Merrin Rockweaver is a dwarf archaeologist with the Explorers' League of Ironforge. She worked at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands before raptors overran the operation.

faq.q: Why is she trapped above the dig site?
aliases: why is merrin at the retreat
faq.answer: Raptors drawn by the large bones the team uncovered overwhelmed the dig, and many lives were lost. Ormer Ironbraid defended Merrin and Prospector Whelgar as they fled to a nearby bluff, where they remain trapped.

faq.q: What does Merrin need help with?
faq.answer: Merrin needs someone to carry a letter about the disaster to her husband Tarrel. He has worried since her letters stopped arriving.

faq.q: What was the expedition trying to find?
faq.answer: The Wetlands expedition sought ancient artifacts tied to dwarven ancestry and the mysterious Titan relics hidden throughout Khaz Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help Merrin protect Titan relics and historical records the Explorers' League risked their lives to uncover.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can help Merrin safeguard Ironforge's research presence in the Wetlands and strengthen the Alliance's tenuous foothold in the wild marshland.
